_meta.purpose: Independent positive, boundary, resolution, and compatibility fixtures for strategy routing v1.1

resolutionFixtureEncoding.string: Enabled target with modelId equal to the string, providerId=fixture-provider, providerProtocol=openai, promptPolicyId=null, targetAvailable=true, contextKind=total_context, contextLimit=128000.
resolutionFixtureEncoding.null: None / disabled rule with no target fields.
resolutionFixtureEncoding.object: Override the string defaults; target is modelId, valid maps to targetAvailable, enabled maps to rule.enabled, and contextLimit without contextKind uses total_context.
resolutionFixtureEncoding.missingKey: Missing rule, equivalent to None at runtime.

_meta.userOverrideFixtureEncoding: userOverride keys are legacy six-class slots and use resolutionFixtureEncoding; the snapshot is synthetic U0 and all object fields, including final promptPolicyId and capacity, are already resolved.

validationFixtureEncoding.targetString: Expands to providerId=fixture-provider, providerProtocol from the rule or openai, modelId=the target string, targetAvailable=true.
validationFixtureEncoding.missingTarget: No providerId/modelId target fields are populated.
validationFixtureEncoding.disabledRule: Any stale target fields are ignored and stripped before persistence.

_meta.apiFixtureContract: Merge each validation case payload over apiFixtureBasePayload; fixture-provider and fixture-general exist and are enabled. updateRoute starts from a persisted copy of the base plus existingTemplate.

expectedFieldContract.classification.expectedContinuationTarge: Deep-equal every field after applying classificationExpectedDefaults.
expectedFieldContract.resolution.expected.outcome/source/layer: Strict equality for every field present.
expectedFieldContract.resolution.expected.traceIncludes: At least one trace reason or fallbackPath outcome equals the value.
expectedFieldContract.resolution.expected.mustNotSelect: During this fixture invocation, the value appears in neither selected target nor any new upstream-attempt target.
expectedFieldContract.resolution.expected.upstreamAttemptsBefo: Exact count of network/upstream attempts before the selection or terminal result.
expectedFieldContract.resolution.expected.bestEffortApplied/re: Strict boolean equality; absent fields are not asserted.
expectedFieldContract.resolution.expected.reason: Assert result reasons contains the value.
expectedFieldContract.compatibility/validation: Strict equality for every expected-prefixed field present; expectedStatus is the HTTP status.

fallbackMatrixExpansion.direct: For every row, create L1 with chain[0] and general enabled (deduplicate when equal); assert chain[0] is selected at L1.
fallbackMatrixExpansion.sameLayerAlias: Only when chain.length > 1, create L1 with chain[0]=None and chain[1] plus general enabled (deduplicate when equal); assert chain[1] is selected at L1.
fallbackMatrixExpansion.crossLayer: For every row, create L1 with every chain member=None and L2 with chain[0] plus general enabled (deduplicate when equal); assert chain[0] is selected at L2.

_meta.arbitrationCaseContract: Each arbitration case produces two assertions: every expectedEvidenceTaskType must match before arbitration, then templatePriority must select expectedTaskType.
notes: Classification cases are intentionally not copied from the seed utterance file.
Case context is merged over defaultContext.
When expectedContinuationTarget is present, compare every object field; omitted expected output fields use classificationExpectedDefaults.
Fixture shorthand hasImageInput sets both currentUserTurnHasImage and outboundPayloadHasImage unless either explicit field overrides it.
origin is harness-only trust provenance; only origin=internal may populate ClassificationInput.internalPurpose.
Resolution layer indexes in expected results are one-based.
These fixtures specify behavior; they do not authorize implementation.
